items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: at 19 I got hired by Terry Gibbs to play with him, you know, Hollywood on Sunset Strip, The Crescendo.

ctx.x: Now those guys followed the path into the studios and I’m assuming they made a pretty good living. Did you aspire to that?

Well Bud was already there. Dennis went there. Dennis Budimir, I don’t know if you know him, was a marvelous guitar player. Extremely creative. And was an influence on Bill Frisell, according to Bill anyway, Bill told me that. We made some records, home recordings that later came out and Bill being much younger than us he had heard them when he was young and he told me once he was extremely influenced by Dennis and those records, which was nice to hear you know. And so what happened — oh it’s still a blur — so…
I love that, sitting with the band. I have it from an inside source that you used to be known as the “bebop newspaper.”
